So as President Trump said, they’ve been, tap, tap tapping. You can see when someone’s trying to tap tap, tap on a deal. Instead, they’re going to have tap, tap tap bombs dropping on key facilities in Iran from the United States of America. And that’s not because we want to restart anything we don’t have to restart.
